krokacondor.bio:
Krokacondor has been a consistent threat to other GMs throughout documented and undocumented history of Mario Baseball CPU leagues. He has consistently guided his team to world series appearances one after another. However, he just cannot seem to reel in the championship titles as he's lost 3 out of 4 championships throughout his time. Regardless, he knows how to draft a competent team.

He will often be seen on the sideline, screaming his lungs out, displaying every single emotion known to humanity. It takes players some time before they're used to his vocal coaching style, but they can see that underneath the volume, there's a passionate man who wants to see his players shine their true potential.
